summary.text: Lillian Bowles is the Democratic candidate for the Utah House of Representatives, District 49, in the November 3, 2026 general election, where the incumbent is Republican Candice Pierucci.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she described herself as a first-generation college graduate and Herriman resident, and listed affordability and public school funding among her priorities.

paragraphs.text: Lillian Bowles graduated from South Point High School, earned an associate degree from Salt Lake Community College in 2021 and a bachelor's degree from the University of Utah in 2023, and is listed by Ballotpedia as self-employed.
In her Ballotpedia survey, she said she has lived in Herriman for 12 years, grew up in poverty, and spent many years as a single mother raising a son with disabilities.

She said she earned degrees in political science and sociology from the University of Utah, worked in financial services and small-business ownership, and worked with refugee and immigrant families through AmeriCorps.

In her survey responses, Bowles said she would focus on fully funding neighborhood public schools, supporting teachers and student mental-health resources, expanding career and technical education, and protecting public education dollars from voucher programs.
She also said she would work with cities on responsible growth, housing choices, infrastructure and childcare solutions.
